basic_info.description: Located in the heart of the vibrant Inner Mission, this beautifully reimagined top-floor Victorian condo seamlessly blends timeless architectural charm with modern design. Thoughtfully renovated, this gorgeous two-bedroom, one-bath flat wows with soaring ceilings, intricate moldings, and period-specific details. Imagine winding down in your grand primary bedroom or relaxing in your spacious living room, featuring large south-facing bay windows that flood the space with natural light. For your convenience, there's also a second bedroom perfect for a home office or overnight guests. At the heart of the home, the kitchen boasts bold blue cabinetry, expansive composite stone countertops, and top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances, including a Bosch oven and Miele refrigerator. Additional highlights include a charming updated bathroom, recessed lighting, and in-unit laundry. Step outside of your front door and you are walking distance to some of San Francisco's most vibrant shops, cafes, iconic restaurants, and nightlife - including Flour & Water, Foreign Cinema, San Ho Won, Lazy Bear, True Laurel, and Trick Dog. Don't miss the opportunity to live at the crossroads of culture and comfort, putting the very best of the Mission District right at your front door.
